name: Roland XV-88
description: Roland XV-88 88-key synthesizer: the system blocks with the keyboard settings, the temporary performance (common, effects, MIDI, the Part block of each of its 16 parts, the keyboard block and its zones), and Part 1's temporary patch and rhythm set, from the MIDI Implementation chapter of the owner's manual.

sources.title: XV-88 MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, February 15, 2000)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from XV-88_OM.pdf (sha256 9158b1e42c56018d89d702c8fa9e2d2e30692fbfa1f85cd8aab72394ae957bf5). Model ID 00 10, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Performance parts are filed as "Part n" (id part<n>.*), Part 1's patch as "Part 1 · Patch · …" (part1.patch.*) and its rhythm set as "Part 1 · Rhythm Set · …" (part1.rhythm.*); the performance's own blocks as "Performance · …" and its MIDI blocks by channel.

LFO1 Wave Form and LFO2 Wave Form (0-10) print their labels as "SIN, TRI, SAW-UP, SAW-DW, SQR, RND, BEND-UP, BEND-DW, TRP, S&H" with "CHS" alone on the next line and no comma before it (the XV-5080's p297; every XV manual sets it so): ten labels for eleven values, so both stay numbers with the manual's line as their description rather than labels that would be off by one.
Rows the manual tags for other models (`<XV-5080>`, `<XV-3080/5080>`, the XV-2020's `<*>`) keep the tag in their name and choice labels, where a reader sees it, and lose it in their ids.

The manual ends each offset-table entry with a reference mark (`Rhythm Tone (Key # 21) *1-3-2-5`), which the reader keeps in the name and which stops it filling in the ":" run after a marked entry; the map then addresses only the entries the manual prints. Left out for that reason, with their addresses: System Part (a scale tune per part), parts 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 00 00 10 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 00 00 12 00 and 15 at 00 00 1E 00; Performance MIDI channels 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 10 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 12 00 and 15 at 10 00 1E 00; Performance Parts 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 20 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 22 00 and 15 at 10 00 2E 00; Performance Zones 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 50 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 52 00 and 15 at 10 00 5E 00; Part 1 Rhythm Set keys 35-81: the map addresses only 21-22, 108 of 21-108; n is at 11 10 10 00 + (n-21) x 00 00 02 00, so 35 is at 11 10 2C 00 and 81 at 11 11 08 00.

Identity: the message line (p278) ends 00 00 00 00 where the byte table beneath it gives the revision as 01 01 00 00; the family code and number, 10 01 and 00 00, agree in both and are what the XV-3080 (p180) and XV-5080 (p289) print, so the three are not told apart by their identity reply as printed. The byte table's labels, "Device family code (XV-3080/5080/88)" and "Device family number code (XV-3080/88)", read as though the XV-5080's number differed, which its own manual does not say. Choosing this profile for an XV-3080 or XV-5080, or theirs for an XV-88, is not flagged as a mismatch.

The Temporary Performance's zones are printed "Performance Zone (Channel n)" (p279) and called Zone 1-16 in the manual (p57-64); they are ids zone<n>.* and groups "Zone n". "Performance Keyboard" (Key Mode, the arpeggiator and D Beam of the performance) is "Performance · Keyboard".

The address map is the XV-5080's, with the XV-5080's rows tagged <XV-5080> and outputs the XV-88 lacks tagged <XV-3080/5080> (p279-288). Those in blocks the XV-88 sends are laid out, tag and all; the Part blocks and scale tunes for Parts 17-32 are not. Solo Part Select (Performance Common 00 0C) is tagged <XV-5080> here, though the XV-3080's manual prints it untagged.

Presets list Patches (Bank Select MSB 87: User 00, PR-A to PR-F 64-69) and Rhythm Sets (MSB 86: User 00, PR-A to PR-F 64-69), p207, recalled on the profile's channel. Not listed: Performances (MSB 85: User 00, PR-A/PR-B 64/65, p206), PR-H's General MIDI 2 sounds (MSB 121/120), the card groups CD-A to CD-H (LSB 32-39) and the expansion boards (MSB 88-93).

p294, <Example 4> lists Part 1's temporary patch at 11 20 00 00 and rhythm set at 11 30 00 00, where the address map (p279) has 11 00 00 00 and 11 10 00 00, and calls keys 21 and 108 "Rhythm Tone 1" and "Rhythm Tone 4". It is an RQ1 and is not checked.
Chorus Type (0-2) and Reverb Type (0-4) print no labels in the address map; the example (p294) gives DELAY as 02.

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): part1.patch, part1.patch.mfx, part1.patch.chorus, part1.patch.reverb, part1.patch.tmt, part1.patch.tone1, part1.patch.tone2, part1.patch.tone3, part1.patch.tone4, part1.rhythm, part1.rhythm.mfx, part1.rhythm.chorus, part1.rhythm.reverb.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the keyboard, sliders, pedals and D Beam transmit and what the instrument receives as Control Change (received p270-273, transmitted p276-278) is not mapped yet
coverage.parts: the Temporary Performance's Part block for every part the map addresses (of 1-16); the temporary patch and rhythm set of Part 1 only. Parts 2-16's are not laid out: Temporary Patch/Rhythm (Performance Mode Part n) is at 11 00 00 00 + (n-1) x 00 20 00 00 (… 14 60 00 00 for Part 16), its patch at +00 00 00 and its rhythm set at +10 00 00, the same blocks as Part 1's
coverage.patchMode: not laid out: Temporary Patch/Rhythm (Patch Mode), the patch or rhythm set played in Patch mode, at 1F 00 00 00 (patch) and 1F 10 00 00 (rhythm set): the same blocks as Part 1's at another base
coverage.toneTypes: Part 1 plays a patch or a rhythm set; both are laid out (patch at 11 00 00 00, rhythm set at 11 10 00 00) and neither is read at startup, since a request the instrument cannot answer gets no reply and the engine's startup read stops at the first request that is not answered
coverage.rhythmKeys: rhythm tones for keys 35-81 (the General MIDI percussion keys) that the map addresses; Rhythm Tone (Key # k) is at the rhythm set's base + 00 10 00 + (k-21) x 00 02 00, so for Part 1 keys 21-34 are at 11 10 10 00-11 10 2A 00 and keys 82-108 at 11 11 0A 00-11 11 3E 00; all eighty-eight would be over twelve thousand parameters on their own
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX, chorus and reverb parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.notModelled: User Performances (20 00 00 00), User Patches (30 00 00 00) and User Rhythm Sets (40 00 00 00): memories, not the edit buffer
coverage.notAddressedByTheMap: System Part (a scale tune per part), parts 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 00 00 10 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 00 00 12 00 and 15 at 00 00 1E 00; Performance MIDI channels 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 10 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 12 00 and 15 at 10 00 1E 00; Performance Parts 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 20 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 22 00 and 15 at 10 00 2E 00; Performance Zones 3-15: the map addresses only 1-2, 16 of 1-16; n is at 10 00 50 00 + (n-1) x 00 00 01 00, so 3 is at 10 00 52 00 and 15 at 10 00 5E 00; Part 1 Rhythm Set keys 35-81: the map addresses only 21-22, 108 of 21-108; n is at 11 10 10 00 + (n-21) x 00 00 02 00, so 35 is at 11 10 2C 00 and 81 at 11 11 08 00
coverage.zones: the Performance Keyboard block and every Performance Zone (Channel n) the map addresses (of 1-16); the manual calls them Zone 1-16 and so do the groups
